node.title: KoalaBear m2 r2 dihedral degree-six common-pole exclusion
node.closure: exact projective automorphism atlas for a common unramified Dickson-six pole fiber plus source-cover twist resultants
node.statement: In the residual full-V4 n=6 profile, the six poles of the common degree-30 function would be one generic fiber of both degree-six dihedral quotients. The two fixed-point-free internal involutions yield only coincident, V4, or S3 matching structures. Exact binary-sextic comparison reduces these to the standard normalizer and the exceptional fibers c=27/8 and c=756/125; none is compatible with the forced source-cover branch quadratic. Thus n=6 is empty and only n=3 remains in the full-V4 dihedral frontier.
